title: Sad Sally
prompt: Sally was sleeping when Jack woke her. She went to the door and found a letter. She read it and began to cry. She now knew that her boyfriend would never see her again. Why?
solution: Sally's boyfriend had recently had eye surgery. Jack, her boyfriend's guide dog, woke her after the postman delivered a letter. It was from the doctor's, in response to her boyfriend's medical tests, and confirmed that the surgery had been unsuccessful and that he would now be completely blind.
